description: This file implements a JSR-311 compliant router for matching HTTP requests to web service routes, including route selection, parameter extraction, and route sorting logic.

classes.name: RouterJSR311
classes.description: Implements request routing based on JSR-311 specifications, matching requests to web service routes with route selection and parameter extraction.

methods.name: SelectRoute
methods.description: Selects the best route for a given web service and HTTP request.

methods.name: ExtractParameters
methods.description: Extracts path parameters from the URL based on route and web service expressions.

methods.name: extractParams
methods.description: Helper method to extract route parameters from matched regex groups.

methods.name: detectRoute
methods.description: Determines the appropriate route based on request method, content type, accept headers, and conditional checks.

methods.name: bestMatchByMedia
methods.description: Placeholder for selecting the best route based on media types; currently returns the first route.

methods.name: selectRoutes
methods.description: Filters and sorts routes matching the URL path remainder.

methods.name: detectDispatcher
methods.description: Identifies the web service dispatcher matching the request path.
